description: Finds components whose name or category contains the search term (one term, case-insensitive substring match) and returns their names with the category slug. Use it when you know roughly what you need, such as 'pricing', 'marquee', 'testimonial' or 'countdown'; use list_components to see a whole category. Names are English PascalCase, so short English words match best. Follow up with get_component for the source.

query.description: One keyword or name fragment, e.g. 'hero', 'gallery', 'bento'. Matched against component names and category slugs and titles.

name: search_components
title: Search components
